summary: Start Iteration 2.1 and fix the reproduction-semantics errors before adding more agent capability.
Reviewed Iteration 2 verifier, evaluator, CLI, and prior trace evidence showing original FAIL + patch FAIL was incorrectly treated as successful reproduction.
Defined discriminating reproduction as original FAIL and patch PASS only. Original PASS/timeout and original FAIL + patch FAIL/timeout become retryable non-discriminating outcomes.
Added Iteration 2.1 verifier with both-version feedback on non-discriminating attempts, separate evidence fields, and dedicated result metadata.
Added separate 2.1 evaluation mode and artifact directory so Iteration 2 results are preserved.
Added --iteration 2.1 as the default advanced path while retaining Iterations 1 and 2.
Added coverage proving original FAIL + patch FAIL is non-discriminating and triggers retry with both execution outputs, while original FAIL + patch PASS is accepted.
Created trace-006 during implementation. Local test and benchmark results remain pending human verification.
